Early DEC systems employed proposal generators like DAP for event detection and enriched the captioning stage with context‑aware S2VT models. Other approaches have leveraged grouping strategies based on video‑highlight detectors and attribute‑augmented LSTMs to improve both proposal quality and linguistic expressiveness. More recent studies have investigated joint optimization of proposals and sentences, using generated captions to refine event proposals or replacing DAP with bidirectional segment‑selection techniques and bidirectional attention mechanisms. These works typically rely on fully supervised training with explicit temporal segment annotations and often use one‑to‑many mapping detectors to retrieve multiple events simultaneously."
